\section[(dialogue)]{Animals, the body and describing words — a first pass}

\label{lesson:MR-R158-first-pass-animals-the-body-and-describing-words}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to obtain and to save.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item stale, raw, calm, lazy, hard-working
  \item honest, brave, timid, foolish, famous
  \item safe, dangerous, false, purple, orange
  \item grey, golden, to climb, to get down, to arrive
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Stale? (\textbf{\mr{शिळा}}, \emph{śiḷā}.) Raw? (\textbf{\mr{कच्चा}}, \emph{kaccā}.) Calm? (\textbf{\mr{शांत}}, \emph{śānt}.) Lazy? (\textbf{\mr{आळशी}}, \emph{āḷśī}.) Hard-working? (\textbf{\mr{मेहनती}}, \emph{mehantī}.) Honest? (\textbf{\mr{प्रामाणिक}}, \emph{prāmāṇik}.) Brave? (\textbf{\mr{धाडसी}}, \emph{dhāḍsī}.) Timid? (\textbf{\mr{भित्रा}}, \emph{bhitrā}.) Foolish? (\textbf{\mr{मूर्ख}}, \emph{mūrkh}.) Famous? (\textbf{\mr{प्रसिद्ध}}, \emph{prasiddh}.) Safe? (\textbf{\mr{सुरक्षित}}, \emph{surakṣit}.) Dangerous? (\textbf{\mr{धोकादायक}}, \emph{dhokādāyak}.) False? (\textbf{\mr{खोटे}}, \emph{khoṭe}.) Purple? (\textbf{\mr{जांभळा}}, \emph{jāmbhaḷā}.) Orange? (\textbf{\mr{नारिंगी}}, \emph{nāriṅgī}.) Grey? (\textbf{\mr{करडा}}, \emph{karḍā}.) Golden? (\textbf{\mr{सोनेरी}}, \emph{sonerī}.) To climb? (\textbf{\mr{चढणे}}, \emph{caḍhṇe}.) To get down? (\textbf{\mr{उतरणे}}, \emph{utarṇe}.) To arrive? (\textbf{\mr{पोहोचणे}}, \emph{pohocṇe}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Describing words and verbs — a second pass}

\label{lesson:MR-R158-second-pass-describing-words-and-verbs}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to return and to set out.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to return, to set out, to run away, to break off, to break
  \item to join, to tie, to sew, to paint, to take out
  \item to show, to play, to shout, to bite, to swallow
  \item to taste, to sow, to grow, to get tired, to stay awake
  \item to wipe, to sweep, to quarrel, to obtain, to save
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To return? (\textbf{\mr{परतणे}}, \emph{paratṇe}.) To set out? (\textbf{\mr{निघणे}}, \emph{nighṇe}.) To run away? (\textbf{\mr{पळणे}}, \emph{paḷṇe}.) To break off? (\textbf{\mr{तोडणे}}, \emph{toḍṇe}.) To break? (\textbf{\mr{मोडणे}}, \emph{moḍṇe}.) To join? (\textbf{\mr{जोडणे}}, \emph{joḍṇe}.) To tie? (\textbf{\mr{बांधणे}}, \emph{bāndhṇe}.) To sew? (\textbf{\mr{शिवणे}}, \emph{śivṇe}.) To paint? (\textbf{\mr{रंगवणे}}, \emph{raṅgavṇe}.) To take out? (\textbf{\mr{काढणे}}, \emph{kāḍhṇe}.) To show? (\textbf{\mr{दाखवणे}}, \emph{dākhavṇe}.) To play? (\textbf{\mr{वाजवणे}}, \emph{vājavṇe}.) To shout? (\textbf{\mr{ओरडणे}}, \emph{oraḍṇe}.) To bite? (\textbf{\mr{चावणे}}, \emph{cāvṇe}.) To swallow? (\textbf{\mr{गिळणे}}, \emph{giḷṇe}.) To taste? (\textbf{\mr{चाखणे}}, \emph{cākhṇe}.) To sow? (\textbf{\mr{पेरणे}}, \emph{perṇe}.) To grow? (\textbf{\mr{वाढणे}}, \emph{vāḍhṇe}.) To get tired? (\textbf{\mr{थकणे}}, \emph{thakṇe}.) To stay awake? (\textbf{\mr{जागणे}}, \emph{jāgṇe}.) To wipe? (\textbf{\mr{पुसणे}}, \emph{pusṇe}.) To sweep? (\textbf{\mr{झाडणे}}, \emph{jhāḍṇe}.) To quarrel? (\textbf{\mr{भांडणे}}, \emph{bhāṇḍṇe}.) To obtain? (\textbf{\mr{मिळवणे}}, \emph{miḷavṇe}.) To save? (\textbf{\mr{वाचवणे}}, \emph{vācavṇe}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
